person_updates.identity_evidence: The private identifier printed for Louise A Consiglio selects an official Army row named Louis A Consiglio. The surname and middle initial agree but the first name conflicts, so the Army identity, grade, date and occupation are not assigned.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The page 90 index prints rare-name Charles Conssoule as a Captain. A U.S. Army Special Operations history identifies Charles Coussoule as an OSS second lieutenant in 1943, and a contemporary theater newspaper identifies Captain Charles Coussoule in OSS's American-Kachin Rangers in 1945. A separate index row uses the Coussoule spelling and remains unmerged.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Boxes 140 and 149 to confirm whether the Conssoule and Coussoule source rows are duplicate references, and identify Charles's pre-service status or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The separate page 95 Charles Coussoule row has a private identifier and Box 149. Its rare near-identical name and the high-confidence OSS officer evidence for Captain Charles Conssoule make duplication plausible, but the rows remain separate pending personnel-file comparison.
person_updates.next_action: When this row reaches the research queue, compare Boxes 149 and 140 before deciding whether it duplicates Captain Charles Conssoule.
